chapters.label: Six workflows, real integration proof, and reproducible failure handling.
Cart follow-up: consent and value pass; a CRM draft waits for review.
Saved fixture approval outcome: internal draft and report receipts; no live writes.
Inventory: 8 units / 4 per day = 2 days of cover; calculated reorder 48 units.
Review intelligence: sentiment, category and urgency with a verbatim source quote.
Product content: source-grounded SEO, meta description, FAQ and local JSON-LD draft.
Customer intelligence: 190 days since purchase produces the dormant segment in Python.
Executive brief: 100 fixture orders, USD 9,947 order total, USD 99.47 AOV.
Separate real Gemini smoke sample: contextual explanation; external dispatch stayed paused.
Failure case: missing consent blocks generation. Duplicate replay keeps 3 receipts unchanged.
Actual published n8n graph: durable intake, duplicate branch, validation and outbox.
Measured fixture workload: 161 events, 152 eligible completions, 9 blocks, 30 duplicates.
Real n8n intake and Gemini draft. Waiting for a human Slack decision.
Failure case: no consent. Blocked before model generation; no external actions.
Actual Slack decision received. HubSpot task and Google Sheets append completed; writes paused.
Duplicate replay: suppressed by n8n intake; one task, one report row, unchanged receipts.
Verified live sample: one completed eligible cart, one policy block, one suppressed replay.
Real Slack, HubSpot and Sheets receipts. Human review was received via signed HTTPS; live dispatch is paused.
User-approved Shopify test: unpublished synthetic Draft, zero price and stock.
Saved in Shopify as Draft. No product publication or customer activity.
Shopify confirms 200 OK on attempt 1. Signature header excluded from capture.
Genuine webhook -> n8n -> Gemini content draft. Zero outbound actions; writes paused.

method: Edited captioned walkthrough. First segment: 11 actual reviewer-page screenshots and one fully loaded n8n canvas screenshot, held for readability, showing saved outputs from actual isolated Engine runs with deterministic fixture providers. One expanded panel displays a separately recorded real-Gemini smoke sample. Buttons inspect saved data and do not execute live APIs. Final 72 seconds reproduce the separately verified live cart and Shopify walkthrough; its provenance is in live-demo-recording.json. No continuous footage or recorded narration is claimed.
